summary: ALTR sent this client one message in seven days, and it was Michelle's templated leak-removal report. That is the whole week. Four messages total (24 last week, 30 the week before, 74 the week before that): Vale on Aug 22 with 'New feed posts are uploaded', 'Working on editing the custom so will upload soon' and 'John’s custom is uploaded', then Michelle on Aug 25. Nobody replied to Vale. She delivered the two things ALTR asked her for — the wall content Ollie chased on Aug 18 and the $2,000 custom fan John paid for in May, on which Ollie had already collected a further $200 for ASAP delivery — and received silence. Ollie has not sent a message since 18:21 on Aug 20: eight days on the account with the most fragile fan-trust record in the book. Six days after she uploaded a three-and-a-half-month-late $2,200 order, nobody has confirmed it reached the fan. Every open item aged another seven days untouched: the Aug 11 PPV breach (her paid private 1:1 live recorded and resold to the fan who bought it) is 16 days past Ollie's only remedy, 'Apologies spoke to the MM PPV specialist for your account and he knows now not to be doing this' — still no written rule, still no confirmation the recordings were pulled. The girl-girl vault purge is 26 days unconfirmed. The lives and Tyler's custom Ollie promised to schedule 'this week' on Aug 9 are 19 days unbooked. Ryan's $600 videocall is 83 days from sale. John's $1,800 videocall, logged by Fred on May 1 against the same OnlyFans account (u490240243) as the $2k custom, is 119 days old and still unreconciled — ALTR cannot say whether this fan is owed one delivery or two. Stephski has not acknowledged Vale's Aug 17 payment in 11 days, against an account number that changed on the Aug 15 invoice, and the next pre-invoice withdrawal reminder is due tomorrow. Mayson: silent 17 days, biweekly call dead 46 days. Vivek's referral routing: 25 days. Derrek: 27 days. This is not a calm week, it is an unattended account. Second consecutive week with no new fan-trust incident, and Vale has now gone two weeks without chasing anything she is owed — after chasing nearly every week since May 22. Read that as a client withdrawing, not a client satisfied.

health.rationale: Down 12 from 60, the sharpest single-week drop on this account. The mechanism: ALTR contributed exactly one message in seven days (Michelle's automated leak report), Ollie went silent for eight days, and the client's three unprompted delivery updates on Aug 22 — including the $2,000 custom carrying a $200 rush fee and a three-and-a-half-month delay — went entirely unacknowledged for six days. Not one of the eleven open commitments moved; they simply aged. Only three things kept this out of the 30s: no new fan-trust incident (second clean week), no invoice fell due in the window so payment discipline was not tested, and Vale herself delivered everything asked of her. Prior scores: 70 (Aug 8), 62 (Aug 14), 60 (Aug 21).
